description: This file contains the implementation of cron job management functions, including starting, stopping, listing, adding, updating, removing, and executing manual runs of cron jobs. It interacts with external modules for task execution, job scheduling, and timer management.

methods.name: mergeManualRunSnapshotAfterReload
methods.description: Updates the in-memory job store with the latest snapshot after a manual run, handling removal or state updates.

methods.name: ensureLoadedForRead
methods.description: Ensures the cron job store is loaded and recomputes next run times in maintenance mode for read operations.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the cron scheduler, clears stale markers, and starts processing missed jobs.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the current status of the cron scheduler, including enabled state and next wake time.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists cron jobs with optional filtering for disabled jobs.

methods.name: resolveEnabledFilter
methods.description: Determines the enabled filter based on options.

methods.name: sortJobs
methods.description: Sorts jobs based on specified criteria and direction.

methods.name: listPage
methods.description: Provides a paginated list of jobs with filtering and sorting.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new cron job to the store and triggers recomputation and timer arm.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing cron job and recalculates next run times.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cron job from the store.

methods.name: prepareManualRun
methods.description: Prepares a manual run for a job, reserving it and creating a task run record.

methods.name: finishPreparedManualRun
methods.description: Completes a manual run, updating job state and possibly removing the job.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes a manual run of a specified job.

methods.name: enqueueRun
methods.description: Queues a manual run command for execution.

methods.name: wakeNow
methods.description: Triggers an immediate wake-up of the scheduler based on mode.
